papers.name: MaskGCT
papers.title: Two-stage speech synthesis
papers.claim: Reference speech conditions both semantic and acoustic generation. Two masked-prediction stages turn text into semantic tokens and then acoustic codes; the acoustic decoder reconstructs speech.
papers.scope: Inference topology only. Duration prediction, iterative refinement steps and the RVQ layer schedule are omitted.

papers.name: Janus
papers.title: Separate visual encoders. One shared model.
papers.claim: Task-specific encoders map semantic image features and discrete visual IDs to a shared autoregressive transformer. Separate heads predict text or image codes; a VQ decoder reconstructs images.
papers.scope: The two visual routes serve different tasks, not simultaneous inputs. The generation encoder supplies training image codes; text-to-image inference starts from text. Modality adapters are collapsed.

papers.name: CUT3R
papers.title: A persistent state that reads and updates
papers.claim: State and image streams interact through paired transformer decoders. The image stream updates the persistent state while reading accumulated context for pointmaps and camera pose.
papers.scope: One time step is shown. The pose token and individual output heads are abstracted; interleaved decoder interactions are condensed. Optional virtual-view queries are not shown.

papers.name: LoftUp
papers.title: Coordinate queries, high-resolution features
papers.claim: Pixel coordinates with sinusoidal encodings and RGB values form high-resolution queries. Low-resolution VFM features supply keys and values. Repeated cross-attention and feed-forward blocks predict high-resolution features.
papers.scope: Architecture only; the two-stage training scheme is omitted. Feature colors are illustrative tensors, not measured activations or qualitative model results.

papers.name: LLaDA
papers.title: Masked prediction as a language model
papers.claim: Training randomly masks tokens and supervises their recovery. During sampling, the prompt remains fixed while response masks are predicted in parallel; low-confidence predictions can be remasked.
papers.scope: Gray outlined cells denote masks. Only representative intermediate states are shown, not a fixed three-step sampler or an empirical decoding trace. SFT is omitted.

papers.name: Transfusion
papers.title: Discrete text meets continuous image latents
papers.claim: One transformer handles discrete text and continuous image latents. Text uses next-token prediction; images use diffusion noise prediction. Causal sequence attention is combined with bidirectional attention inside each image.
papers.scope: Modalities are grouped schematically, not drawn as exact shifted text targets. BOI/EOI mark image boundaries. VAE and modality-specific adapters are collapsed.
